searchText: Anyone here runs Lighthouse with the latest release? I'd love to verify the payload_attributes SSE event paylaod before recommending using it besides Prysm v4.0.0+. It would be super helpful if someone could grab a few event payloads and send them to me to double-check with Prysm! 🙏 ```curl <LIGHTHOUSE_NODE>/eth/v1/events?topics=payload_attributes``` Sepolia or Zhejiang testnets would be ideal! Not seeing anything from lighthouse 4.0.1 on sepolia, any configuration required for lighthouse to emit these? <@602753420033785856> do you know? yeah I would say `--always-prepare-payload --prepare-payload-lookahead 12000` and some (junk) suggested fee recipient if not set already cc <@144468805697929216> I can also get some tomorrow, I'm afk now That seems to do the trick. (And a quick diff of lighthouse Vs. prysm events shows the same information in each.) can you confirm they are completely identical <@144468805697929216>? i seem to have different parents for the same proposal_slot between your lighthouse payloads and my prysm payloads for Sepolia That could have been because lighthouse was still catching up after being kicked to start with the new parameters. Recent ones are identical. (except for the fee recipient, but that's a local config value different for each beacon node on my setup.) okay great, thanks a lot! i'll go ahead and recommend lighthouse v4.0.1+ also as an option for relays going forward (we can finally deprecate our custom Prysm fork, and use this for the relay, and the builder is also in the process of being updated) If anyone is interested in this relay alpha release: https://github.com/flashbots/mev-boost-relay/releases/tag/v1.0.0-alpha2 General question, worth considering increasing the logging default level of `mev-boost`? Even debug logging simply isn't that verbose, and tends to be useful to, well, debug issues. haven't had that request before, I do think it becomes a bit more user-unfriendly, although maybe worth it. if you feel strongly about it, perhaps open a discussion with an issue on the repo? would love to hear other thoughts here too okay. I don't feel that strongly yet about it, will have to investigate the exact logging levels more first

excerpts.author: metachris_
excerpts.content:
Anyone here runs Lighthouse with the latest release? I'd love to verify the payload_attributes SSE event paylaod before recommending using it besides Prysm v4.0.0+. 

It would be super helpful if someone could grab a few event payloads and send them to me to double-check with Prysm! 🙏 
```curl <LIGHTHOUSE_NODE>/eth/v1/events?topics=payload_attributes```
Sepolia or Zhejiang testnets would be ideal!

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: Not seeing anything from lighthouse 4.0.1 on sepolia, any configuration required for lighthouse to emit these?

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content:
yeah I would say `--always-prepare-payload --prepare-payload-lookahead 12000` and some (junk) suggested fee recipient if not set already

cc <@144468805697929216>

excerpts.author: sproul
excerpts.content: I can also get some tomorrow, I'm afk now

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: That seems to do the trick.

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: (And a quick diff of lighthouse Vs. prysm events shows the same information in each.)

excerpts.author: metachris_
excerpts.content: can you confirm they are completely identical <@144468805697929216>? i seem to have different parents for the same proposal_slot between your lighthouse payloads and my prysm payloads for Sepolia

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: That could have been because lighthouse was still catching up after being kicked to start with the new parameters.  Recent ones are identical.

excerpts.author: jgm
excerpts.content: (except for the fee recipient, but that's a local config value different for each beacon node on my setup.)

excerpts.author: metachris_
excerpts.content: okay great, thanks a lot! i'll go ahead and recommend lighthouse v4.0.1+ also as an option for relays going forward

excerpts.author: metachris_
excerpts.content: (we can finally deprecate our custom Prysm fork, and use this for the relay, and the builder is also in the process of being updated)

excerpts.content: General question, worth considering increasing the logging default level of `mev-boost`? Even debug logging simply isn't that verbose, and tends to be useful to, well, debug issues.
